ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated at the distal tips and localized linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-pigmented field across both lobes. High-contrast white geometric clusters (barnacles) are located at the lateral-most distal tips. Sparse white point-mottling and parallel vertical lines are mapped on the medial-lateral section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch; the precise vertex is obscured by white-water splash pixels, but the visible slopes suggest an acute angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration profile with sharp, jagged peaks occurring at irregular intervals of approximately 10-30 pixels along the entire trailing margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward curve exhibiting a distinct convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel regions (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips and along the anterior margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Group of 3-4 parallel vertical white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear rake marks on the left lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both lobes.
